mapper.sql: c.id, c.content_type, c.author_id, c.title, c.description, c.subject, c.grade, c.lesson_type, c.keywords, c.version, c.license, c.status, c.is_top, c.view_count, c.use_count, c.like_count, c.favorite_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, COALESCE(lik.like_cnt, 0) AS like_cnt, COALESCE(stat.fav_cnt, 0) AS fav_cnt, COALESCE(stat.use_cnt, 0) AS use_cnt, COALESCE(stat.view_cnt, 0) AS view_cnt FROM com_content c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS like_cnt FROM com_like WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY target_id ) lik ON lik.target_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fav_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'derivation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS use_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_cnt FROM com_interaction WHERE action_type IN ('favorite', 'derivation', 'view') AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY target_id ) stat ON stat.target_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'public' AND c.content_type = #{contentType} AND (COALESCE(lik.like_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(stat.fav_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(stat.use_cnt, 0)) >= #{threshold} ORDER BY (COALESCE(lik.like_cnt, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(stat.fav_cnt, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(stat.use_cnt, 0) * 4 + COALESCE(stat.view_cnt, 0) * 0.2) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
